items.description: Says provider must support the requested pair
Says provider must admit the client region
Says quote must not be after request.now
Says quote must not be older than now minus maxQuoteAge
Says available amount must be strictly positive
Says provider must satisfy regulatory venue rules
Says BUY uses ascending price order
Says SELL uses descending price order
Explains sequential greedy splitting across providers
Explains allocation is min(provider available, remaining)
Explains partial legs are returned when liquidity is insufficient
Correctly maps FLEXIBLE=all, US_SEF_REQUIRED=SEF only, EU_MTF_REQUIRED=MTF only
Correctly recognizes now and now-maxQuoteAge boundaries as inclusive

critical_errors: Reverses BUY or SELL price ordering
Claims stale quotes older than maxQuoteAge are eligible
Maps US_SEF_REQUIRED or EU_MTF_REQUIRED to the wrong venue
Claims a provider may be used despite failing an eligibility condition
